description.la: Breve epitaphium monachorum: capitula de recta via iustorum ad regnum caelorum, de custodia cordis, de invocatione nominis Iesu et Mariae, de consolatione animae et aliis.
description.en-US: A short book on the narrow way of the just to the kingdom of heaven: guarding the heart, calling on the names of Jesus and Mary, the soul's true consolation, silence, the cleansing of the heart. Latin only: Pohl's critical edition (Freiburg 1918), from a raw OCR of the printed volume; no public-domain English translation has been found.
description.pt-BR: Breve livro sobre o caminho reto dos justos para o reino dos céus: a guarda do coração, a invocação dos nomes de Jesus e Maria, a verdadeira consolação da alma, o silêncio.

sources.edition: Thomae Hemerken a Kempis Epitaphium monachorum, ed. M. J. Pohl (Freiburg: Herder 1918), Opera omnia IV; archive.org raw OCR (Pohl 1918 volume).
sources.description: Chapters as Pohl divides them, with his upper-case chapter titles recased (u/v normalised by script). Line numbers, running heads and page breaks stripped by script; Pohl's critical footnotes and introduction are not imported. Raw OCR: drop capitals at chapter openings and isolated letters are often garbled; a chapter heading lost to OCR runs two chapters together.
